annotations.text:
Flow: spin the wheel → tap an outer feeling (e.g. Frustrated) → see the needs that may be unmet (NVC) → craft a response.
The wheel drags to spin, chips and tabs are tappable in this prototype; navigation between the three screens isn't wired.

Assumptions: working title "Attune" (placeholder). Feeling taxonomy adapted from the classic feelings wheel; needs list and the 4-step response from Marshall Rosenberg's NVC. Sample path shown: Frustrated → Effectiveness.
